en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
that Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> curcified a man at Al-Hira, for three days. Then he<sup>asws</sup> brought him down on the fourth day, so he<sup>asws</sup> Prayed over him and buried him’.
